design_philosophy: High-energy minimalism. The UI must feel physical, active, and youthful. We discard the soft 'SaaS' look in favor of stark contrasts, bold colors, and tactile bento-grid layouts. Every interaction should feel like a physical button press or a card sliding.

typography.rules: Never use generic Sans like Inter for headings. Use massive sizes for key numbers (like participant counts) with tight tracking.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8). The Bento Grid Protocol for mobile feeds.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_shadows: Use 'Tactile Neo-Brutalism': 2px solid black borders on primary cards with solid black offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]) to make them pop.
layout_and_spacing.radii: rounded-3xl for main cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons.

component_rules.buttons: Primary CTA must be vibrant (Primary #FF4747 or Secondary #FFE600) with a 2px black border and a solid black shadow. Text must be uppercase, tracking-widest, font-bold.
component_rules.cards: Activity cards use the Bento layout. High contrast. White background, 2px black border. Include a bold category pill.
component_rules.inputs: Solid off-white/gray background, 2px border on focus, large tap targets (h-14).
component_rules.chips: Horizontal scrollable chips for categories. Active state: black background with white text. Inactive state: white background with black border.
component_rules.bottom_nav: Floating bottom bar, rounded-full, with high-contrast icon active states.

login.layout: Hero image filling the top 60% of the screen. Bottom 40% is a solid white sheet with a massive bold headline ('Pronti a giocare?') and the Google Login button.
login.visuals: Use the social hero image with a subtle black/20 overlay.

home_feed.layout: Header with 'Esplora' + User Avatar. Sticky category filter chips. Vertical scroll of activity cards.
home_feed.card_design: Show category icon, bold title, location, date/time, and a visual participant progress bar (e.g., 5/10) using vibrant accent colors.

create_group.layout: Progressive disclosure or single long-scroll form. Massive input text for the Title. Tap-heavy selectors for Time/Date (avoid native spinner if possible, use tactile grid buttons). Sliders for age range.

group_detail.layout: Hero section with category-specific imagery. Overlapping avatars for participants. Floating sticky bottom bar with the 'Join/Partecipa' button and chat access.

chat.layout: Standard mobile chat. User's bubbles in Primary (#FF4747), others in light gray. Clean, distraction-free input area.

profile.layout: Large circular avatar with a 3px black border. Name. Segmented control (Creati vs Partecipati) styled as large tactile tabs. Logout button at the very bottom.

login_hero.description: Group of friends laughing, used for the main landing/login screen.

category_sports_fallback.description: Silhouettes playing sports, used as a fallback header for sports groups.

category_nightlife_fallback.description: Club/Bar environment, used for nightlife/disco groups.

category_social_fallback.description: Friends hanging out, used for general social/bar groups.

icons: Use lucide-react-native. Map specific icons to categories (e.g., Basketball -> basket, Trophy -> calcio, Music -> discoteca, Beer -> bar).
instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo app. DO NOT use HTML tags (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, TextInput.
Apply Tailwind classes using NativeWind standard practices (className).
CRITICAL: Include `data-testid` on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) to ensure testability.
Implement the 'Tactile Neo-Brutalism' aesthetic: Use solid borders and solid shadow offsets on cards to make the UI feel vibrant and physical.
Never use generic transparent headers over images without a dark overlay or glassmorphism effect to ensure text readability.
Build a robust bottom tab navigation for Home, Crea, Profilo.
Ensure all Italian copy is vibrant and youthful (e.g., 'Crea il tuo gruppo!', 'Unisciti alla partita').
